cause: Cartesian dot product along a lattice vector does not identify cell face coordinates in an oblique lattice. Other lattice vectors contribute to the dot product.
fix: Bound each resized face using fractional coordinates of original positions in the drag-start lattice; preserve near-face Cartesian translation and validated atomic preparation.

baselineBrowserCases.structures: original graphene, shrink a and b

finalBrowserCases.coverage: Both skew signs, both near/far faces, preview containment, release, Undo/Redo; graphene atom move followed by shrinking a/b with current extrema.

relatedBrowserCases.coverage: Atom/frame picking, boundary movement plane, bond previews, capture loss and next gestures

containment: Atom centers are bounded. Spheres can straddle faces at boundary sites. Existing out-of-cell source coordinates are not automatically wrapped or relocated.
